review.interpretation: No blanket HTTP pass. The mainnet synced=true expectation ignored the current stale/unknown observation; the transaction result exposed an actual height discrepancy. The other checks prove their bounded response or proxy assertion only.
review.actualTransactionDefect: The observed containing block hash resolves to height 965545. Transaction responses reported 965334 in the prior public observation and 965332 through the candidate proxy; both are inconsistent with that containing block.
review.addressLimit: Identity and the 164-transaction summary were compared; zero amount aggregates and full pagination were not independently established.
review.outspendLimit: Only the returned spent boolean was compared; no spending transaction/witness or complete consumer journey was established.
